summary: VersaBank filed a Form 6-K on October 15, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the U.S. commercial launch of its proprietary tokenized deposit program. VersaBank USA will issue its own Real Bank Tokenized Deposits, branded VUSD, described as interest-paying, FDIC-insurance-eligible, U.S.-dollar deposits represented on blockchain, with planned listing on digital asset exchanges. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private, spin-off, capital return, or management change is involved. This is an ordinary product-launch current report, not a special situation; monitor regulatory acceptance and deposit-gathering economics rather than deal terms.
